create_network_factory: create a network factory that instantiates meta-optimizer networks from class names and options
save_network_variables: save network variables to disk using pickle serialization with module and variable name keys
build_standard_deep_lstm: build a standard deep LSTM network with configurable layers, preprocessing, and output size
build_adam_optimizer: build an Adam optimizer network that tracks first and second moment estimates for gradient updates
create_sgd_identity_network: create an SGD identity network that returns scaled negative gradients as updates
